business_problem: Sanabil Investments, a financial services company in Saudi Arabia, needed to enhance productivity by reducing the time employees spent on manual everyday tasks, diverting focus from more strategic and valuable work.
solution_summary: Sanabil Investments built this solution on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Teams. Sanabil Investments, a financial services company in Saudi Arabia, needed to enhance productivity by reducing the time employees spent on manual everyday tasks, diverting focus from more strategic and valuable work. Microsoft 365 Copilot assists employees with drafting, summarization, and information retrieval inside daily work tools. Microsoft Teams presents collaboration workflows and shared communication experiences to end users. Sanabil Investments collaborated with Netways to adopt Microsoft 365 Copilot through structured adoption plan, including hands-on workshops and custom training content. Sanabil’s IT department automates day-to-day business processes. Documents, meetings, and collaboration context remain in Microsoft 365 while Copilot generates grounded drafts, summaries, and answers directly inside daily employee workflows.
